- "LOCK": commit amount confirmed and any contract/rev holds cleared, or
- "ADJUST: <new amount>" with one-sentence reason (procurement delay, PO pending, legal redline, etc.), or
- "REMOVE": move to risk bucket (reason).

- We have three large deals (Acme, Singula, Peregrine) with ambiguous stage mapping. Please reference stage_mapping_reference.pdf for correct stage -> commit definitions.

Please respond by EOD Thursday 2026-12-03 so I can prepare the rollup for leadership. If you anticipate any blockers to meeting that timeline, flag here so I can escalate to finance/product.
